Specific guidelines of the manual evaluation are as follows: Consistency with User Profile... Consistency with Dialogue History... Consistency with Domain Knowledge... Consistency with Subgoals...

Annotators (three NLP graduate students) independently judged each pair of responses using win/tie/lose labels for each of four consistency aspects: user profile, dialogue history, domain knowledge, and subgoal.

The evaluators are asked to assign one of three possible labels (i.e., "win", "tie", or "lose") to two anonymous responses, designated as A and B. ... Consistency with User Profile: ... whether A and B contradict the user profile ... Consistency with Dialogue History: ... logically coherent with the dialogue history ... Consistency with Domain Knowledge: ... correctly utilize domain knowledge ... Consistency with Subgoals: ... correctly achieve the subgoals
